title: NEEDS INSTRUCTIONS
text: NEEDS INSTRUCTIONS. I LOVE that I can slice fruits and veggies very thin and uniformly. Works great! And I would give it 5 stars just for that. IF that was all it was supposed to do. But it's supposed to do more. I don't know how to change the blades, use the grater, or have any idea what the pop up blades on the mandoline do. Have looked on YouTube and haven't found the answers there either. I found directions for other mandolins but not this one. Am I the only one who actually needs instructions with this? Sorry to be so dumb, Mueller, but really, you couldn't include an instruction manual? Guess all I can do is slice my veggies perfectly thin and just wish I knew how to do more. Not going to slice a finger off trying to figure the rest out with nothing to go by.
